import cv2, numpy as np, time

# Test 1: Basic swap with FaceSwapPipeline \(default mode\)
print\("=== Test: FaceSwapPipeline \(default mode\) ==="\)
try:
    from face_swap_pipeline import FaceSwapPipeline
    pipe = FaceSwapPipeline\(model_path="models/ghost_2_256.onnx", enhance=False, timing=True\)
    src_img = cv2.imread\("images/1/1-1.png"\)
    faces = pipe.detect\(src_img\)
    src_face = faces[0]
    print\(f"Source face loaded OK"\)
    
    # Use source as target too \(self-swap test\)
    t0 = time.perf_counter\(\)
    result = pipe.process_frame\(src_img.copy\(\), src_face\)
    dt = \(time.perf_counter\(\) - t0\) * 1000
    print\(f"process_frame took {dt:.0f}ms, output shape: {result.shape}"\)
    cv2.imwrite\("test_pipeline_output.jpg", result\)
    print\("Saved test_pipeline_output.jpg"\)
except Exception as e:
    import traceback
    print\(f"PIPELINE ERROR: {e}"\)
    traceback.print_exc\(\)

print\(\)

    cfg.enable_codeformer = False

    print\("Saved test_ultimate_output.jpg"\)
